moveEffects.name: Fake Out
moveEffects.originalDescription: Slap its hands together, shoving enemies in front of it. Mr. Mime claps, damaging and knocking back enemies hit for 0.4s.
moveEffects.summary: Slap its hands together, shoving enemies in front of it. Mr. Mime claps, damaging and knocking back enemies hit for 0.4s.

moveEffects.name: Light Screen
moveEffects.originalDescription: Create a wall of light in the designated area that prevents enemies from passing. Mr. Mime creates a wall that prevents enemies from passing. If an enemy is near the location where the wall is created, they are shoved and left unable to act for 0.5s.
moveEffects.summary: Create a wall of light in the designated area that prevents enemies from passing. Mr. Mime creates a wall that prevents enemies from passing. If an enemy is near the location where the wall is created, they are shoved and left unable to act for 0.5s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Showtime
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Jump to the designated location and start a pantomime performance, dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act for a short time. Mr. Mime leaps forward and begins a performance; stunning enemies for 0.5s, dealing damage in a large area around him 4 times, and becomes unstoppable for the duration. The final hit deals double damage and stuns enemies for 1s. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield
